description: Every 10 years, we are asked to complete our civic duty and respond to the census, but until I was in office, I never thought about what an impressive, important and, quite frankly, genius endeavor the U.S. census is. As an arts educator, I have a great interest in the story and the thought process
title: It’s Not Too Late: Let’s Make Our Census Work For Us — Heather Bagnall - Maryland State Delegate - District 33
